name: SynthIPTV Jellyfin Compatibility
overview: Makes Jellyfin 12 Live TV playback compatible with SynthIPTV without replacing Jellyfin FFmpeg.
description: Applies the required SynthIPTV Live TV timestamp compatibility corrections inside Jellyfin while preserving Jellyfin's stock FFmpeg and stream-copy playback.

versions.changelog: Initial release. Adds native Jellyfin 12 compatibility for SynthIPTV Live TV playback.
